The PR is flagged ready for the independent review.

This PR is a draft again. A read of the diff after the quick pass found two points that do not obey AGENTS.md. The head is still 384183cf4a4be5b9f3c873791d3bcf0efac8355d.

1. "`app` holds the document, nothing else": `crates/app/src/posting_scan.rs` has the `use` lines `super::files`, `std::path` and `std::sync::Mutex`. No `use` line names the ECS world, the project file, a command, MCP or the CLI. By the rule, the scan belongs in the crate that owns the values (`camcraft-post`, beside `data_dir::list_files`), and `app` re-exports it. Alternatively, the PR body says why the file must be in `app`.
2. The structural twin: the PR adds a Refresh button to the machine page and to the post picker. The diff changes no UI test. `page_layout.rs:203` asserts only "Machine library" and "Load machine (.mch)". No assertion in `structural.rs` or `page_layout.rs` covers the new buttons.

Smaller points:
- The Gate map line of `crates/app/tests/folder_lists.rs` (line 6) cites #2307 and uses the `app::` form.
- The body has no before and after screenshots of the two pages. The maintainer requires them for a UI PR.
- The line under "Not exercised" about the quick gate is out of date.

Points that are in order: no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in production code; no raw world call in the UI files; no new dependency; no snapshot PNG, workflow file or process file; no file went past 400 lines because of this PR.

A worker changes these points on this branch. Then the gate runs again, and the PR is flagged ready again.

Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`): 232 steps, 0 failed, 23.1 min. Clippy on the three crates is clean. The PR stays a draft.

Read-only independent review (Opus, diff only, not built) of head 0679b49f543a77f6c58c7599e5ed33dc1edf87dc.

Verdict: blockers

## What I checked
- The diff of the 16 files, issue #2380, AGENTS.md and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`.
- The code around the diff at the head sha (`posting.rs` `script_of`, `post_ref_label`, `default_post_for`; `pages.rs` `post_section`).
- The four screenshot files on the `screenshots` branch (`gh api`, the files exist). I did not open the images.
- No build and no test run by this review.

## Blocker
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:197-208`: the post combo can panic, and it can show the wrong post.
   - Line 197 now filters `names` by the scan. Line 199 still maps `PostRef::Builtin` to `Some(0)`. Line 208 indexes `names[i]`.
   - Before this PR, `names` was the full `BUILTINS` table, so index 0 was always the default post.
   - Case A: the post folder does not read, or it has no file of the table. Then `names` is empty. A document with `PostRef::Builtin` (the default for a mill) panics at `names[0]` in each frame of the Setup Post page. This is a panic on a path that a user can start (Prime Directive).
   - Case B: the file of `BUILTINS[0]` is removed, and other posts stay. Then `names[0]` is a different post. The combo shows that post as selected. The label above it and `script_of` still use `BUILTINS[0]`. The combo does not show what the document posts with.
   - Fix: resolve `PostRef::Builtin` by name (`posting::post_name`) and find its position in the filtered `names`, as `PostRef::Named` does. Use `names.get(i)`, not `names[i]`. A missing default then shows as "custom" or with its missing name, and `script_of` refuses it by name.
   - Add a pinning test: a post scan without the first table file, and a `PostRef::Builtin` document, gives no panic and no wrong selection. The pure selection logic can move to a small function that a unit test can call.

## Not blockers
- Diagnostics: an unreadable folder is logged (`posting_files.rs` `read_scans`, `tracing::error!`). The UI shows only an empty list with no message. `FolderScan::problem` is not shown on the machine page or in the post picker. Consider one weak line under the list.
- `crates/post/src/data_scan.rs:41`: the scan matches file names case-insensitively. `builtin_post_text` and `builtin_machine_text` open the exact table file name. On Linux, `FANUC.CPS` lists "Fanuc" and the read then refuses. There is no crash, because the refusal names the file.
- MCP: `mcp/setup_tools.rs` `machine_names` now filters `MACHINES` by `posting::machine_scan()`. MCP has no tool that calls `posting::rescan`. An MCP session does not see a file that was added after the first scan. Issue #2380 asks that MCP follows the same scan. Follow-up: an MCP verb for the refresh, or a rescan in the MCP list tool.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_page.rs:37-39` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:171-179`: the doc comment of `machine_page()` and of `post_section()` now attaches to the new `REFRESH_*` const. Move each const above its doc comment.
- The decision record says that a file that was read once and removed later still posts from the cached text until restart. This is recorded and the label stays the same, so the post choice is not changed. Keep it tracked as a follow-up issue (no buried owed items).

## Points in order
- Scan: `scan_folder` and `list_files` return an error value, never panic, and open no file. The `unwrap_or` at `data_scan.rs:47` is `Option::unwrap_or`. The `Mutex` lock in `posting_files.rs:205,223` recovers from poison. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in production code.
- No disk scan in each frame: the UI reads the cached `FolderScan` (`machine_scan`, `post_scan`). The folders are read at first use and at `rescan` only.
- A removed machine that a setup uses: `library_row` uses `position` and `get`, so it shows "other". No crash.
- Layers: the scan is in `camcraft-post` (`data_scan.rs`, with a provenance comment), and `app` re-exports it (`posting.rs`). The process cache is in `posting_files.rs` beside the tables. No new file in `crates/app/src`. No new `camcraft-*` dependency. The UI calls `posting::rescan` only, no world or `sys_*` call.
- Commands: Refresh is a cache read, not a document change, so it needs no undoable command. The new list entries use the existing `LoadMachineFile` and `SelectPostFile` commands.
- File size: `posting_files.rs` is 399 lines (main 320). `pages.rs` (691) and `setup_tools.rs` (432) were already over 400 on main. No file goes past 400 because of this PR.
- Tests: `crates/post/tests/folder_scan.rs` imports only `camcraft_post` and has its Gate map. `crates/app/tests/folder_lists.rs` imports `camcraft_app` and has its Gate map with `camcraft_app::`. `structural/folder_refresh.rs` checks role, label and enabled state, and that a press reads the folders again. `layout_page_setup_machine` names "Refresh machine list". No test is deleted or ignored. No snapshot PNG changed. The tests do not cover the blocker above.
- PR body: it has what changed, the root cause, the readings, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2380`. It names the author's quick gate on 0679b49f5 (232 steps, 0 failed). This review did not run it. The four screenshot links point to `pr-2414/*.png` on the `screenshots` branch. The four files exist (188-229 KB).
- Comment 6972372749: point 1 (the scan in `camcraft-post`, `posting_scan.rs` removed) is met. Point 2 (a structural test for the two buttons) is met.
- Posted G-code: `script_of` and `post_ref_label` do not change. `PostRef::Builtin` and `PostRef::Named` still resolve through `BUILTINS` and `builtin_post_text`, independent of the scan. A missing file is refused by name. A folder change under a setup does not change the post script that a program uses. Only the combo display (blocker above) can disagree with it.

Review fix at 5733391a12f077698157946441e263f638c6e531

This fixes the blocker of review comment 6975429429.

What changed:
- The post combo finds the document's post by name (`posting::post_name`) in the scanned list. The new file is `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_pick.rs`.
- The code uses `.get`, not `[]`. An empty or unreadable post folder does not cause a panic.
- A post whose file is not in the folder shows its own name with "(file missing)". The combo does not show a different post as selected. The document's post does not change.

- The other non-blocking findings are not changed.

Pinning tests (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/folder_refresh.rs`):

- `a_removed_first_post_is_not_shown_as_another_post`

Without the fix, the first test panics at `names[0]`, and the second test finds "Haas" as the selected text.

Merge of main at 6b9df50bbc405cf9b80b961f5a9494a1e07f8795

This merge brings in main after #2370. One file had a conflict, and I resolved it by hand.

Hand-resolved hunks in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_page.rs`:
- `machine_page()` (about lines 43-68): the call is `library_row(ui, state, &path)` from main. The `names` list for the "Source" line is main's full `MACHINES` list again. A mounted machine whose file is gone still shows as "Built-in: <name>".
- `library_row()` (about lines 85-135): main's catalogue list is kept (user files first, then the shipped library, refused files not selectable). The shipped part of that catalogue is already the folder scan of this PR (`library::enumerate_with` uses `shipped_entries(&posting::machine_scan())`). Thus the PR's own `names` and `extra` lists in this function are removed.
- The Refresh row of this PR is kept. A press now calls `posting::rescan()` and also clears the cached catalogue (`reread = true`), so the list shows the new scan.

No behaviour of the two sides is lost.

Targeted gate on 6b9df50bb:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1108 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test folder_lists`: 2 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test folder_scan`: 2 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Without `--no-deps`, clippy stops at `crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128`. That error is on main and is not from this PR (#2479).

**Verdict: no blockers**

Read-only re-review (Opus) of head 6b9df50bbc405cf9b80b961f5a9494a1e07f8795. The earlier review is comment 6975429429 on head 0679b49f5. This review reads the review fix 5733391a1, the merge 6b9df50bb (`git show --remerge-diff`) and `git diff origin/main...` of the branch.

## 1. The blocker of the earlier review is fixed
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_pick.rs` `choose` finds the document's post by name through `posting::post_name`. `PostRef::Builtin` resolves to `BUILTINS.first()`, the same name that `script_of` uses.
- The selected text uses `names.get(i)`. No index, `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is on this path. The test-only `SCAN_FOR_TEST` is `#[cfg(test)]`.
- An empty or unreadable folder: `names` is empty, `sel` is `None`, and the combo shows `<default name> (file missing)`. The page also shows `FolderScan::problem` under the picker (`pages.rs` `post_section`).
- A removed first post: the combo shows the default post as missing. It does not show a different post as selected.
- The picker sends a command only on a click (`SelectPostNamed`, `SelectPostFile`). The document's post is not changed silently.

## 2. The merge 6b9df50bb
- The only hand-resolved file is `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_page.rs`. After the merge, the diff of that file against `origin/main` is only the `REFRESH_MACHINES` const and the Refresh row (12 lines).
- Nothing of #2370 is lost: `library_row` keeps main's catalogue (user files first, then the shipped library, refused files not selectable). `actions` ("Load other") is the same as on main.
- Nothing of this PR is lost: the shipped part of the catalogue is `library::enumerate_with` -> `shipped_entries(&posting::machine_scan())` (`crates/app/src/machine/library.rs:247`). The PR's own `names`/`extra` lists are correctly dropped. The Refresh row stays.
- The reread flag cannot loop. A Refresh press calls `posting::rescan()` one time and sets `reread = true`. Then `state.machines_pane.list = None`, and `machines_pane::refresh` builds the list again one time on the next frame. Nothing sets `reread` in each frame. No disk read occurs in each frame: `machine_scan()` and `post_scan()` read the cache.

## 3. Tests and files
- `an_empty_post_folder_shows_the_default_post_as_missing` and `a_removed_first_post_is_not_shown_as_another_post` pin the two cases of the blocker. They assert the combo role and its value text, and the label of the folder message. They assert no position, size or colour.
- `crates/ui` `#[test]` count: 4 added, 0 removed against main. No test is ignored. No snapshot PNG changed.
- New files: `post_pick.rs` 68 lines, `folder_refresh.rs` 108 lines. `posting_files.rs` is 399 lines. `pages.rs` (682), `mod.rs`, `structural.rs` and `setup_tools.rs` were over 400 lines on main already.
- The author's targeted gate on 6b9df50bb is in comment 6976511585 (`camcraft-ui --lib` 1108 passed, `folder_lists`, `folder_scan`, clippy clean). This review did not run it.

## 4. PR body
- It has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2380`. The four screenshot links are present. The test names are current, and the two review-fix tests are named.

## Not blockers
- PR body, "Readings": the last gate reading is on 5733391a1. Add the reading on the merge head 6b9df50bb from comment 6976511585.
- Screenshot `machine-page-after.png` was rendered before the merge of #2370. The machine combo on this head is main's catalogue with the Refresh row. Consider one new "after" render of the machine page.
- `post_pick::scan()` clones the cached `FolderScan` and `choose` builds `names` in each frame. This is a small list copy under a mutex, not a disk read. It is acceptable. A cache in `State` keyed on a scan generation is possible later.
- The follow-ups of the earlier review are not yet tracked as issues: an MCP verb or rescan for the folder lists; the case-insensitive scan match against the exact table file name on Linux; a removed file that still posts from the cached text until restart. File them as `P7` (no buried owed items).
- The label of this PR is still `needs-rework` from the earlier review. The merging session sets the label after this review.
